import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        private static int modValue = 1000000009;
        private int value;

        public Modular() {
            this.value = 0;
        }

        public Modular(int x) {
            this.value = normalize(x);
        }

        public static void setMod(int m) {
            modValue = m;
        }

        private static int normalize(int x) {
            int v = x % modValue;
            if (v < 0) v += modValue;
            return v;
        }

        public int getValue() {
            return value;
        }

        public Modular add(Modular other) {
            value = (value + other.value) % modValue;
            if (value >= modValue) value -= modValue;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular sub(Modular other) {
            value = (value - other.value) % modValue;
            if (value < 0) value += modValue;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular mul(Modular other) {
            long x = (long) value * other.value;
            value = (int) (x % modValue);
            return this;
        }

        public Modular div(Modular other) {
            return mul(other.inverse());
        }

        public Modular inverse() {
            return power(this, modValue - 2);
        }

        public Modular power(Modular base, int exp) {
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) result.mul(base);
                base.mul(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Modular add(int x) {
            return add(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular sub(int x) {
            return sub(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular mul(int x) {
            return mul(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular div(int x) {
            return div(new Modular(x));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    static int n, m;
    static List<Modular> fact;
    static List<Modular> invFact;

    static Modular C(int x, int y) {
        if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Modular(0);
        int sz = Math.max(x, y);
        while (fact.size() < sz + 1) {
            int size = fact.size();
            fact.add(fact.get(size - 1).mul(size));
            invFact.add(new Modular(1).div(fact.get(size)));
        }
        return fact.get(x).mul(invFact.get(y)).mul(invFact.get(x - y));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int md = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Modular.setMod(md);

        fact = new ArrayList<>();
        invFact = new ArrayList<>();
        fact.add(new Modular(1));
        invFact.add(new Modular(1));

        Modular[] ptrDp = new Modular[m + 1];
        Modular[] ptrWays = new Modular[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptrDp[i] = new Modular(0);
            ptrWays[i] = new Modular(0);
        }
        ptrWays[0] = new Modular(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular c = C(l + r, l);
                Modular add = new Modular(l + r + 2);
                ptrWays[i] = ptrWays[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(c).mul(add));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular c = C(l + r, l);
                Modular add = new Modular((int) ((long) l * (l + 1) / 2 + (long) r * (r + 1) / 2));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(c).mul(add));
                Modular term = ptrDp[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).add(ptrDp[r].mul(ptrWays[l]));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(term.mul(c).mul(new Modular(l + r + 2)));
            }
        }

        Modular[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Modular(0);
                ways[i][j] = new Modular(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptrDp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptrWays[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Modular ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Modular way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    Modular c = C(s, add);
                    Modular ptrWaysAdd = (add >= 0 && add < ptrWays.length) ? ptrWays[add] : new Modular(0);
                    Modular ptrDpAdd = (add >= 0 && add < ptrDp.length) ? ptrDp[add] : new Modular(0);
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.mul(ptrWaysAdd).mul(c));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(way.mul(ptrDpAdd).add(ptrWaysAdd.mul(ft)).mul(c));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m].getValue());
    }
}
